title: AxPortableBlocks
description: 一个简单的随身工作方块插件，仅需要一个命令就能打开各种工作方块/A simple portable workbench plugin that allows you to open various workbenches with just one command
body:
英语、ENGLISH

A portable crafting table plugin for a Minecraft server
Tested server versions: 1.20-26.1.2

You only need to enter the /pb parameter to use it, no permission configuration is required.
Currently available blocks:

Anvil: /pb anvil

Crafting Table: /pb crafting

Cartography Table: /pb cartography

Loom: /pb loom

Grindstone: /pb grindstone

Smithing Table: /pb smithing


Author contact: QQ: 177232558

Look forward to more updates

中文。CHINESE


一个Minecraft server的随身工作方块插件
测试过的服务器版本1.20-26.1.2


仅仅只需要输入/pb + 参数 即可使用，无需任何权限配置
目前已有方块：

铁砧：/pb anvil


合成台：/pb crafting


制图台：/pb cartography


织布机：/pb loom


磨石：/pb grindstone


装备升级台：/pb smithing


作者联系方式：QQ：177232558

更多更新尽情期待
